note: ufillelo 'elohim: 'elohim may be "God" or "judges", and pillel may mean "arbitrate" or "intercede". The contrast with "against Yahweh, who can intercede?" suggests God or a divine arbiter.

kjv: thou (Eli) shalt see an enemy in my habitation
mine: in distress you (Eli) will look with envious eye
note: wehibbatta tsar ma'on is obscure ("you will look on distress of dwelling"). The KJV supplies "in my". Every rendering is conjectural.

kjv: shall die in the flower of their (Eli's descendants') age
mine: shall die by the sword of men
note: The MT reads yamutu 'anashim ("shall die as men", that is, in their prime). I followed the Septuagint and 4QSam-a's "by the sword of men"; the KJV interprets the MT.
